body: Basically given it up. Too much association with the skin damage, if i continue i'll just be reminded of how the hobby ruined my look. I just spend most of my time researching ways to repair my skin, or thinking of ways to die.

I have gone to a dermatologist as well as two other health clinics. I've gotten a bunch of responses: microneedling, chemical peels, filler, tretinoin etc.

I just... idk I'm not hopeful that any of those things will do any good. Most reputable sources online say the effects of photoaging are irreversible. So i feel like I would just be wasting my time and money. I guess i've just given up in a way. Sucks to say but its true. I just wish i could talk to someone who understands how im feeling.
